# JTE Recruit

> JTE Recruit Pte Ltd is a Singapore recruitment agency (MOM Employment Agency Licence 14C7215) that helps employers hire — permanent, contract and outsourced — with particular strength in engineering, logistics & supply chain, manufacturing and healthcare. Founded in 2014, with 50+ years of combined recruitment experience. JTE works on behalf of employers and is paid by them (permanent roles on a success-fee basis); it never charges job seekers.

## About
- Legal name: JTE Recruit Pte Ltd
- Founded: 2014
- Who we serve: employers hiring in Singapore — JTE is not a job-search service for individuals
- Address: 1 Gateway Drive, #10-14 Westgate Tower, Singapore 608531
- Email: ask@jte.com.sg
- Website: https://jte.com.sg
- Employment Agency Licence: 14C7215 (Singapore Ministry of Manpower)
- Rating: 4.8★ from 325 Google reviews

## Services (for employers)
- Permanent hiring
- Temporary & contract staffing
- Manpower outsourcing
- Payroll & work pass management
- Project & mass hiring
- Employer branding & culture
- HR advisory

## How employers engage JTE
Contact JTE through the website form or by email (ask@jte.com.sg) for a no-obligation conversation about a role. Permanent placements are charged on a success-fee basis — the employer only pays on a successful hire, with terms agreed upfront. Contract, temporary and outsourced arrangements can include payroll and work-pass handling.

## Scam / impersonation warning (important)
Scammers impersonate JTE consultants on WhatsApp, offering fake high-paying work-from-home "task" or "deposit" jobs. JTE will NEVER ask anyone to pay money, make a deposit, or complete paid tasks — genuine recruitment is never charged to job seekers. Anyone who does is a scammer. Verify whether a WhatsApp number belongs to a genuine JTE consultant at https://jte.com.sg/verify
